name: Skip title
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
Skips the title screen and goes directly to New Game option. This way you can handle your title screen from an empty map, completely customizable with default engine commands or other plugins. Also adds extra options to open the load menu and settings menu, normally only available from the title screen.

Note: the Load Game scene was meant to be used from the title screen only, so it still draws the default title screen background when called. One simple workaround is to set the title screen background to an empty (transparent) png.

commands.name: Open load menu
commands.description: Open the title screen load menu (title screen background still applies)

commands.name: Open settings menu
commands.description: Open the title screen settings menu
